block-guide:
YOAST/HOW-TO-BLOCK (Yoast How-to) Step-by-step instructions. Yoast SEO adds a HowTo with one HowToStep per step to the page's structured data. The block exists only while Yoast SEO is active. ONE per post or page (the editor allows no second one). The HowTo's name is the page title, not a block attribute. EACH TEXT IS WRITTEN TWICE OR MORE - Steps: "name" / "text" (what the editor shows) and "jsonName" / "jsonText" (what goes into the structured data) in the comment, and the same text in the HTML. The editor checks the HTML against name / text; the structured data reads ONLY jsonName / jsonText. - Description: the editor reads it from the HTML (

); the structured data reads "jsonDescription" from the comment. No "description" key in the comment. Keep them equal. A step with neither jsonName nor jsonText is left out of the structured data. MARKUP (the shape the Yoast editor saves)

- The HTML is one line: no spaces or line breaks between the elements. - id: unique on the page ("how-to-step-" + a number); the step's HTML id and its #anchor in the structured data. With no description the empty

stays. - Step text may hold inline HTML; in the comment the editor writes < > & as < > &. - "unorderedList":true turns the
    into a
      . PITFALLS - Duration ("hasDuration", "days", "hours", "minutes" as strings) adds a "Time needed" line to the HTML and totalTime to the structured data.
